notes.content:
1. Game voiceovers have been added to the game. Now, you can trigger the detective's voice by clicking on the entry

2. After completing the first and second acts, a character story was added each time (Lian Shanchen, Peng Jianghuan/Li Ming).

3. The English version of the game is initially available

4. Some entries have been added

5. Some joint clues have been added

6. The display logic of the entry button has changed now

notes.title: 2025.03.17更新说明
notes.content:
1.在第一案中，为游戏添加了一个初学者引导，以期帮助玩家更好的上手游戏

2.现在搜索已经搜索过的词条后，将会出现“xxx”词条已在“地点、人物、物品”栏出现的文字

3.现在玩家搜索出了本案所有答案后，会出现“关键信息已备齐”的字样

4.在各人各事中，如果有四个以上的故事，会出现左右箭头以提示玩家

5.修补了游戏在一些分辨率下游玩不便的情况

6.现在鼠标移出显示框外，也能够正确的复制划过的字

7.对游戏内的字体略微进行了加粗，希望能增加字体清晰度

8.修复了第二周目中仍然能选择案件的情况

9.略微更改了游戏的文字内容，让后续剧情更为顺畅

10.在选择某个词条后，添加了其他没有联合内容的词条会文字右移的效果

11.将电脑ui界面向右拓展，以增加游戏界面

12.为了节约游戏的界面空间，词条的圆圈装饰和文字靠的更近了

1. Solved the problem that some computers with lower performance and versions are stuck in the game transition interface. At present, according to the cpu performance of the computer, the transition interface may still be stuck and the animation is not smooth, but it will not be stuck in the game transition interface.

2. Two non-mandatory questions have been added to the second act

3. Changed the font of the answer screen

4. Added music to the transition interface

5. Fixed some typos in the game
